title: Processing UPS World Ease Groups

children:
A UPS World Ease group consists of the container(s) whose final destination 
 is the same intermediate consignee (Hub). A group is created when a shipping 
 container is manifested. If a group already exists for a certain Hub destination, 
 then the system will add the container to the existing group. You can 
 view the containers assigned to a group from the World Ease Insight. When a group is closed, you will be able to print the appropriate 
 World Ease documentation.

The following values 
 need to be provided on shipments that you want to manifest using UPS World 
 Ease:

World Ease Flag Accessorial on the Shipping 
 Container: This is setup to always apply to every container that 
 uses UPS World Ease.

Intermediate Consignee Account Number on the 
 Shipment: This is a nine-digit code supplied by UPS. This 
 code represents a hub's address and the postal code range that the hub 
 supports.

Enter a value 
 into the search criteria field(s).

Press Search. 
 The system will display in the Results Tab the World Ease group(s) that 
 match your criteria. Each group will have either an Open or Closed status. 
 An Open group can still have containers associated with it. For more information 
 on Closed groups, see the section on closing groups below.

Access the World Ease Insight. Perform a search for 
 the appropriate World Ease group. To close a group, right-click a group 
 and choose the Close Group option:

You cannot associate additional containers to 
 a closed group.
A closed group cannot be reopened.

If a group is open and you close the manifest 
 associated with it, the system will automatically close the group as well.

The system does not generate paperwork automatically 
 as part of the Close Group action. Instead, after you close a group, you 
 will have to manually initiate printing via the Print Action. You will 
 prepare the paperwork that goes in the Document Box after a group is closed. 
 You can print the following documents from the insight screen: World Ease 
 Certificate of Origin, World Ease Document Box Label, World Ease Consolidated 
 Invoice, and World Ease Master Invoice.

If a shipment is on this group, but also has product 
 that is not yet packed into a container, the system will associate this 
 unpacked quantity with another group when it is manifested.

Once a group is closed, Progistics will start 
 a new group for any new containers that are going to that particular Hub 
 (along with new MSN numbers, etc).
